rules.zh: 目標表達【Could】並不是固定句型的一部分；核心句型只是：【I was wondering if / whether + clause】 詞語【Could】常用於禮貌請求，但並非每句都必須使用。我想請問你可否把檔案傳給我。 我想知道檔案是否已經傳送。 兩句都完整正確，但用途不同。
rules.en: Could I was wondering if / whether + clause With could I was wondering if you could send me the file. Without could I was wondering whether the file had been sent.

rules.zh: 後面使用陳述句語序這是一個間接問題，所以 if 或 whether 後面不可使用直接問句語序。
rules.en: If / whether I was wondering if you could help me. I was wondering if could you help me. I was wondering whether the shop was open. I was wondering whether was the shop open.

rules.zh: 把直接問句改成 I was wondering if 或 whether 的間接問句後，通常不再保留助動詞 do、does 或 did；時態和人稱變化要在主要動詞上顯示。
rules.en: Do, does Direct question: Does the course include lunch? Indirect question: I was wondering whether the course includes lunch. I was wondering whether does the course include lunch.

rules.zh: 不一定只表示過去在這個句型中，I was wondering 經常用來減弱語氣，令問題或請求聽起來不那麼直接。第二句雖然使用 was wondering，但可以用來提出現在的請求。
rules.en: Was wondering Direct: Can you check this paragraph? Softer: I was wondering if you could check this paragraph.

rules.zh: 在這裏不是條件句我想知道商店是否營業。 這裏的 if 表示「是否」。如果商店營業，我便會進去。 這裏的 if 表示「如果」。
rules.en: If Compare: I was wondering if the shop was open. I will go inside if the shop is open.

rules.zh: 和 whether 的基本分別兩者都可以用於一般的是非問題。兩句都正確。以下情況通常較適合使用 whether：正式語境；列出兩個選擇；使用 whether or not；句子較長，需要清楚標示選擇關係。
rules.en: If I was wondering if the manager was available. I was wondering whether the manager was available.

rules.zh: 保留正確時態現在情況：【I was wondering if the office is open today.】 我想知道辦公室今天是否開放。 較早發生的事情：【I was wondering whether the payment had been received.】 我想知道付款是否已經收到。 未來安排：【I was wondering whether the meeting would finish before six.】 我想知道會議會否在六時前結束。
rules.en: I was wondering if the office is open today. I was wondering whether the payment had been received. I was wondering whether the meeting would finish before six.

rules.zh: 標點目標表達【I was wondering if / whether】本身通常構成陳述句，因此正式寫作中可以使用句號。在非正式電郵或短訊中，有些人會加問號，以突出請求語氣，但本練習統一使用句號。
rules.en: I was wondering if / whether I was wondering if you could review this paragraph.

benefits.zh: 令請求聽起來更有禮貌直接說：【Send me the document.】 可能顯得像命令。使用：【I was wondering if you could send me the document.】 可以讓對方感到你是在提出請求，而不是要求對方一定要服從。
benefits.en: Send me the document. I was wondering if you could send me the document.

benefits.zh: 避免問題聽起來太直接第二句特別適合用於電郵、工作場所、顧客服務和與不太熟悉的人交談。
benefits.en: Direct: Is the manager free? Softer: I was wondering if the manager was free.

benefits.zh: 同一個句型可以提出不同類型的問題你可以用它：請別人做事；詢問自己可否做某事；詢問資料；詢問兩個選擇；確認某件事是否已經發生。因此，掌握一個句框便可以應付很多日常和工作場合。
benefits.en: The same frame can make requests, ask permission, request information, ask about two choices or check whether something has happened. One structure is therefore useful in many everyday and workplace situations.

benefits.zh: 讓你先交代背景，再提出問題你可以先解釋時間、原因或情況，再提出請求。由於限期將至，我想請問我們可否明天見面。 這樣可以讓對方立即明白你提出問題的原因。
benefits.en: As the deadline is approaching, I was wondering if we could meet tomorrow.

benefits.zh: 幫助你掌握間接問題的語序這個句型要求 if 或 whether 後面使用陳述句語序。反覆練習後，你會較容易避免以下常見錯誤：【if can you...；whether is he...；if does the course...】 這對日常說話、電郵和考試寫作都很實用。
benefits.en: if can you... whether is he... if does the course...

benefits.zh: 讓你更自然地提出較敏感的問題有些問題涉及時間、金錢、安排或別人的決定。太直接地詢問可能令人不舒服。比：【Is the fee refundable?】 聽起來更謹慎，也給對方較大的回應空間。
benefits.en: I was wondering whether the fee was refundable. Is the fee refundable?
